assumptions.choice: Calculated position size as (0.001 * total portfolio equity) / current close price.
assumptions.reason: Specification dictates position size equal to 0.1% of capital per trade.

assumptions.choice: Positions held for 3 completed bars following the entry execution bar are closed via self.close() if TP/SL levels are not breached.
assumptions.reason: Specification states to close the position after 3 bars if TP/SL have not triggered.

assumptions.choice: Positions are closed at or after 15:55 intraday, and new entries are blocked from 15:55 onwards.
assumptions.reason: Specification requires no overnight holds and closing all positions 5 minutes before US session close (16:00 EST).

assumptions.choice: Configured broker percentage slippage to 0.0005 (0.05%) directly on self.broker in strategy initialization.
assumptions.reason: Specification requests a fixed slippage of 0.05% per trade.
